summary: 23 of 40 pass (17 fail). No fabricated quotes: every evidence quote I checked is on the page it names (a few are elided or a line or two off). The failures fall into four groups. (1) Directed types were chosen by feel and break SCHEMA §4: enables where the arrow is backwards or overstated (LoRA Trainer to ComfyUI, CAD Drafter to Blender, Observable Plot's fix to deepens), deepens for one tool hosted in another (Figure Rig), exemplifies where the page itself says deepens (Frame Designer to Blocked, Not Prompted), and a contestable direction kept as deepens (Marcus). (2) New links argued from one page: the three No Mind Checks Itself proposals, Blender/Depth Anything, and Smith/CAD Drafter. In each, only one side names the other, or neither does. (3) Softening where the rule says cut: AuK to ffmpeg and ffmpeg to Endosymbiosis have no reason on either page, and Creative Coach/Sidechain keeps a label whose only sentence is in a Harvest file. (4) Stale reads of the frontmatter: several proposals act on edges this weave has already removed or labelled (Mermaid, Manim, Marcus, the hub-to-Suzuki edge, the 'five links' on Plot/D3). The Mermaid one would write a duplicate if applied. One cut fails the other way: Dialectic/Oblique Portrait has a stated reason (Dialectic.md:98) that the reader disputed rather than failed to find. Two passes carry cautions for the applier. Blender to Blocked, Not Prompted must replace BNP's edge, not add a second one. Cage to Eno is a held citizen edit for Loudon, and its rationale misstates the third encounter, which dissolved the split.
